newsitem.title: UK: FTSE 100 edges higher at the open as futures firm.
newsitem.headline: FTSE 100 edges higher at the open as futures firm.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index, which cleared the 4,000 point hurdle on Wednesday, edged higher in early Thursday trading amid a rising futures market.
But investors may turn more cautious ahead of the release of key U.S. employment statistics for September, due on Friday afternoon, dealers said.

"The (U.S. jobs) numbers are pretty crucial and we usually live in fear of them for about a week before they're out. We may see some short-term profit-taking at some stage, but I don't think it will take too much froth off the market," said one.
At 0744 GMT, the FTSE 100 was up 5.9 points at 4,021. The December futures contract rose 10.0 to 4,056.0.
